title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that L is approximately equal to L'.

title: Power Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for power radiated into the lens using the given parameters.

title: Solid Angle Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the solid angle subtended by the lens at the image.

title: Neglecting Attenuation
description: Important Criteria: The student should justify the assumption of neglecting atmospheric and lens attenuation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect sign usage or missing factors in the equations.
